description: Save an audience segment: a name plus a filter (platforms, tags, follower range, minimum mentions or negatives, intents seen, keyword kinds mentioned or never mentioned, first seen within N days, linkHosts they have shared a link to). Evaluated on every read, never materialized.

automated.description: true: only people whose matched posts are mostly machine-made (bot accounts); false: only the rest.

intents.description: At least one mention carrying any of these intents.

keywordKinds.description: Mentioned a keyword of any of these kinds.

linkHosts.description: At least one mention linking to any of these hosts, the host itself or a subdomain of it.

maxFollowers.description: At most this many followers. Unknown reach never matches.

minFollowers.description: At least this many followers. Unknown reach never matches.

minMentions.description: At least this many matched mentions.

minNegative.description: At least this many negative mentions.

muted.description: true: only muted people; false: only unmuted.

neverKeywordKinds.description: Never mentioned a keyword of these kinds.

newSinceDays.description: First seen within this many days.

notIntents.description: Nobody whose mentions carry any of these intents.

notPlatforms.description: Nobody with an account on these platforms.

items.description: Platform: bluesky, hackernews, github, stackoverflow, devto, reddit, x, youtube, news, linkedin, tiktok, instagram, appstore (App Store reviews), googleplay (Google Play reviews), trustpilot (Trustpilot reviews), googlemaps (Google reviews of a place).

notTags.description: Nobody carrying any of these tags.

ownerIds.description: People owned by any of these members (user ids); "none" matches people nobody owns.

platforms.description: People with an account on any of these platforms.

items.description: Platform: bluesky, hackernews, github, stackoverflow, devto, reddit, x, youtube, news, linkedin, tiktok, instagram, appstore (App Store reviews), googleplay (Google Play reviews), trustpilot (Trustpilot reviews), googlemaps (Google reviews of a place).

stages.description: People at any of these outreach stages.

items.description: Where your workspace stands with the person: not_contacted, contacted, replied, in_talks, customer or not_a_fit.

tags.description: People carrying any of these tags.
